name: Fuu-chan's Idol Adventure
source:
Have you ever wondered how idols come to be? Even the biggest stars start somewhere. In this Visual novel you follow two idols in the making, and their unexpected tutor, on their way to the limelight.

This visual novel was made for the anime convention ConFusion

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190718172545/https://touwaku.itch.io/fuu-chans-idol-adventure]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过偶像是怎么来的？即使是最伟大的明星也从某个地方开始。在这部视觉小说中，你将跟随两位正在成长中的偶像，以及他们意想不到的导师，踏上成为众人瞩目的焦点的道路。

这部视觉小说是为动漫大会ConFusion制作的

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190718172545/https://touwaku.itch.io/fuu-chans-idol-adventure]Itch.io[/url]]
